description: This file implements signal handling utilities, including a SignalMasker class for managing signal masks and a function to change signal handlers, within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: SignalMasker
classes.description: A RAII class that sets a signal mask upon construction and restores it upon destruction.

methods.name: SignalMasker
methods.description: Constructor that sets the thread's signal mask to the provided signals.

methods.name: ~SignalMasker
methods.description: Destructor that restores the previous signal mask.

methods.name: ChangeSignalHandlers
methods.description: Function to set a custom handler for a list of signals.
